# group.dataset.GroupDataset { #fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset }

```python
GroupDataset(
    assays,
    space,
    subjects,
    contrasts,
    col_data=None,
    row_data=None,
    contrast_data=None,
    metadata=dict(),
)
```

Materialized group-analysis data.

Assays are stored as ``sample x subject x contrast`` float64 arrays.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `shape` | Return ``sample x subject x contrast`` shape. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [assay](#fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.assay) | Return one assay by name. |
| [assay_names](#fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.assay_names) | Return assay names in deterministic order. |
| [with_assays](#fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.with_assays) | Return a dataset with replaced assays and preserved axes. |

### assay { #fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.assay }

```python
assay(name='beta')
```

Return one assay by name.

### assay_names { #fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.assay_names }

```python
assay_names()
```

Return assay names in deterministic order.

### with_assays { #fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset.with_assays }

```python
with_assays(assays, *, metadata=None)
```

Return a dataset with replaced assays and preserved axes.
